about_the_game:
In this universe, a down-on-their-luck couple find themselves in impossible debt. These two characters will be your squad to command:

Isaac specializes in all things offense, using weapons from assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, tasers, and grenades to quell the enemy threat.

Sona focuses on all things defense, using healing magic and divine blessings to keep the two standing strong. She can even revive the dead, giving her partner a second fighting chance should he go down.

Start out as two underequipped foot soldiers, taking on whatever contracts may be available. Explore the mission site, defeat enemies in your way, complete the objective, and gain credits for your troubles.

Credits serve two purposes:

Unlike conventional turn-based games, there is no level system. Instead, you will use your credits to purchase various equipment and equipment upgrades that the game has to offer. Arm each freelancer with their own set of upgrades which help bolster their efforts on the field and introduce more mechanics to use in combat.

Furthermore, you can allocate a portion of your credits towards debt repayment. At certain milestones of debt, you will be granted various boosts to moneymaking, helping you accelerate your progress to freedom.

With enough upgrades and strategy, the duo will be able to take on more lucrative contracts, and, with enough perseverance, pay off the impossible amount of debt that lies ahead.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Dual-Core, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 1000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 640 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Storage: 550 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible
  • VR Support: No VR Support

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS Big Sur 11+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Dual-Core, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 1000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 5000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 640M / AMD Radeon HD 6750M
  • Storage: 550 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (Ver. 21H1)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 1000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 550 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: No VR Support

short_description: A turn based RPG focused on paying off an impossible debt of 1 trillion credits. Start as a squad of underequipped freelancers fighting enemies for menial pay. Mix and match equipment upgrades and synergies to take on harder, but more lucrative contracts to eventually win the couple their freedom.
